summary: Comprehensive Hindi translation testing for Heroic HIFI Foundation. All translations are correctly implemented across all pages (Home, About, Missions, MissionDetail, Donate, Volunteer, Contact, Login/Register, Community). The language toggle (EN/HI) works correctly and switches all text sitewide when navigating via React Router links. Minor UX note: language state is stored in React context only, not localStorage, so direct URL navigation or page refresh resets to English.

issues: Language state is stored in React context only, not persisted to localStorage. Direct URL navigation or page refresh resets language to English. This is a minor UX enhancement opportunity, not a bug.

passed_tests: Language toggle button (EN/HI) in header switches all text sitewide
Home page: hero section, missions grid, drives section, CTA section - all text in Hindi when switched
About page: story paragraphs, vision, legal info - all in Hindi
Missions page: mission names (from data), 'Learn More' (और जानें) link text in Hindi

Mission Detail page: 'All Missions' (सभी मिशन) back link, 'Donate to This Mission' (इस मिशन के लिए दान करें), 'Volunteer for This Mission' (इस मिशन के लिए स्वयंसेवक बनें), 'Ask a Query' (प्रश्न पूछें) buttons in Hindi
Donate page: all form labels (पूरा नाम, ईमेल पता, फ़ोन नम्बर, पैन नम्बर, आधार संख्या, पता, सन्देश), PAN help text (80G अनन्तिम प्रमाणपत्र), submit button (ईमेल सत्यापित करें और दान करें) in Hindi

Contact page: all form labels (आपका नाम, आपका ईमेल, मिशन चुनें, विषय, आपका सन्देश), 'Blood Donation Drives' / 'Community Kitchen (Langar)' in dropdown, submit button (प्रश्न भेजें) in Hindi
Login page: login form labels (ईमेल, पासवर्ड), title (पुनः स्वागत है), button (साइन इन करें) in Hindi
Register page: all form labels (पूरा नाम, ईमेल, पासवर्ड, फ़ोन, आयु, जन्म तिथि, पता, पैन नम्बर, आधार संख्या), PAN/Aadhaar privacy note (80G कर रसीद), OTP flow text in Hindi

Community page: title (समुदाय), subtitle, directory/messages tabs (निर्देशिका/सन्देश), Connect button (जुड़ें), search placeholder (नाम से खोजें...), security notice, role labels (प्रशासक/स्वयंसेवक) in Hindi
Footer: tagline (हृदय और उद्देश्य से मानवता की सेवा), quick links heading (त्वरित लिंक), legal section (विधिक), connect heading (जुड़ें) all in Hindi
Nav bar: all links in Hindi including 'Community' (समुदाय) for logged-in users, Dashboard (डैशबोर्ड), Logout (लॉग आउट)
action_items: OPTIONAL: Consider persisting language preference to localStorage for better UX across page refreshes/direct URL navigation
critical_code_review_comments: translations.js has comprehensive EN/HI translations for all sections - well structured
All pages correctly use useLang() hook and translations[lang] pattern
Mission names/taglines come from missions.js with name_hi, tagline_hi, description_hi fields - working correctly
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hindi translations are fully implemented and working. All pages switch correctly between EN/HI when using the language toggle. The language state is stored in React context (LanguageContext.js) and resets to English on page refresh. This is expected behavior but could be enhanced by persisting to localStorage. Admin Dashboard tabs remain in English as per design (internal tool).
